episodes.name: Manifesto
episodes.overview: Troubled student Fakhri enrols in the prestigious all-boys boarding school, KUDRAT. Inside, he uncovers a sinister organisation controlling the students and reunites with his estranged brother Naim.

episodes.name: Of Mice & Men
episodes.overview: Fakhri and his dorm mates continue to be hazed by the High Council and they begin to learn the consequences for snitches.

episodes.name: Bad Roots
episodes.overview: Fakhri gets a suprise visit from his mother as he preps for the tournament. He also opens up about his past and troubles that arose 6 years ago that led to his estrangement from Naim.

episodes.name: Laid Bare
episodes.overview: The Form 4 class face their worst fears when they attend the yearly “Honeymoon Camp”.

episodes.name: Ashes to Ashes
episodes.overview: Mr Sin and Mrs Faniza’s suspicions arise as the Form 4 students return sick after the “Kem Bulan Madu” & an indignant Fakhri confronts Kahar to put an end to the oppresive order by the seniors.

episodes.name: Predators
episodes.overview: Naim uncovers dark secrets that even the students aren’t aware of when Amirr reveals his traumatic past.

episodes.name: Power Trip
episodes.overview: The school authorities suspicions increase following Ariz’s case. Naim and Mia’s relationship blossoms. Meanwhile, Fakhriah begins to lose his grasp on his noble goals as power begins to corrupt him.

episodes.name: Kingdom of Flies
episodes.overview: Kahar’s reign begins to falter as the Form 4 students retaliate against him due to Fakhri’s influence. Pressure builds up between the Form 5 and Form 4 students.

episodes.name: Parallel
episodes.overview: The school opens an investigation following Ayam’s case. While Fakhri’s guilt weighs upon him, Prakash urges Fakhri to stop his upcoming fight with Naim before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Men Don't Cry
episodes.overview: The grim truth is exposed. The state of the school, its traditions, as well as Fakhri and Naim’s future are on the line as confessions come to light.
